import zipfile, re, sys

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "quarterly_report.docx"

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    names = z.namelist()
    print("=== ZIP ENTRIES ===")
    for n in names:
        print(n)
    data = z.read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8")

print("\n=== DOCUMENT.XML (pretty-printed) ===")
# naive pretty print: indent
out = []
indent = 0
for m in re.finditer(r"<[^>]+>", data):
    tok = m.group(0)
    if tok.startswith("</"):
        indent -= 1
        out.append("  " * indent + tok)
    elif tok.endswith("/>"):
        out.append("  " * indent + tok)
    elif tok.startswith("<?") or tok.startswith("<!") or tok.startswith("<!--"):
        out.append("  " * indent + tok)
    else:
        out.append("  " * indent + tok)
        indent += 1
print("\n".join(out))

import zipfile, sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

NS = {"w": "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"}

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "quarterly_report.docx"

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    data = z.read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8")

root = ET.fromstring(data)
body = root.find("w:body", NS)
paras = body.findall("w:p", NS)
print(f"Total paragraphs: {len(paras)}")
for i, p in enumerate(paras):
    ppr = p.find("w:pPr", NS)
    style = ""
    jc = ""
    if ppr is not None:
        ps = ppr.find("w:pStyle", NS)
        if ps is not None:
            style = ps.get("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}val")
        j = ppr.find("w:jc", NS)
        if j is not None:
            jc = j.get("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}val")
    # collect text from all runs (w:t), delText, and note underline/bold flags
    texts = []
    fmt = set()
    for r in p.iter("{http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main}r"):
        rpr = r.find("w:rPr", NS)
        if rpr is not None:
            if rpr.find("w:u", NS) is not None:
                fmt.add("U")
            if rpr.find("w:b", NS) is not None:
                fmt.add("B")
        for t in r.findall("w:t", NS):
            texts.append(t.text or "")
    txt = "".join(texts)
    tag = f"[{i}] style={style or '-'} jc={jc or '-'} fmt={','.join(sorted(fmt)) or '-'} text={txt!r}"
    print(tag)

import zipfile, os, sys, shutil
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"
XML = "http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace"

path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "quarterly_report.docx"
tmp = path + ".tmp"

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    entries = [(i, z.read(i.filename)) for i in z.infolist()]
    data = z.read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8")

root = ET.fromstring(data)

# register every namespace declared on the root so serialization keeps prefixes
for k, v in root.attrib.items():
    if k.startswith("xmlns"):
        prefix = k.split(":", 1)[1] if ":" in k else ""
        ET.register_namespace(prefix, v)

body = root.find(f"{{{W}}}body")
underlined_paras = []

for p in body.findall(f"{{{W}}}p"):
    texts = []
    for t in p.iter(f"{{{W}}}t"):
        texts.append(t.text or "")
    txt = "".join(texts)
    letters = [c for c in txt if c.isalpha()]
    is_headline = bool(letters) and all(c.isupper() for c in letters)
    if not is_headline:
        continue
    for r in p.iter(f"{{{W}}}r"):
        rpr = r.find(f"{{{W}}}rPr")
        if rpr is None:
            rpr = ET.SubElement(r, f"{{{W}}}rPr")
            r.remove(rpr)
            r.insert(0, rpr)
        if rpr.find(f"{{{W}}}u") is None:
            u = ET.Element(f"{{{W}}}u")
            u.set(f"{{{W}}}val", "single")
            # schema order: u comes after highlight, before effect; append is fine here
            rpr.append(u)
    underlined_paras.append(txt)

new_xml = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n' + ET.tostring(
    root, encoding="unicode"
)

with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for info, content in entries:
        if info.filename == "word/document.xml":
            z.writestr(info, new_xml)
        else:
            z.writestr(info, content)

os.replace(tmp, path)

print(f"Underlined {len(underlined_paras)} headline paragraphs:")
for t in underlined_paras:
    print(f"  - {t!r}")

import zipfile, sys
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

W = "http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/wordprocessingml/2006/main"
path = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "quarterly_report.docx"

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    bad = z.testzip()
    print("zip integrity:", "OK" if bad is None else f"BAD: {bad}")
    print("entries:", len(z.infolist()))
    data = z.read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8")

root = ET.fromstring(data)
body = root.find(f"{{{W}}}body")

issues = []
count_u = 0
for i, p in enumerate(body.findall(f"{{{W}}}p")):
    texts = []
    for t in p.iter(f"{{{W}}}t"):
        texts.append(t.text or "")
    txt = "".join(texts)
    has_u = any(r.find(f"{{{W}}}rPr") is not None and r.find(f"{{{W}}}rPr").find(f"{{{W}}}u") is not None
               for r in p.iter(f"{{{W}}}r"))
    letters = [c for c in txt if c.isalpha()]
    is_headline = bool(letters) and all(c.isupper() for c in letters)
    if has_u:
        count_u += 1
    if is_headline and not has_u:
        issues.append(f"headline NOT underlined: {txt!r}")
    if not is_headline and has_u and txt.strip():
        issues.append(f"non-headline underlined: {txt!r}")

print(f"paragraphs with underline: {count_u}")
if issues:
    print("ISSUES:")
    for x in issues:
        print("  ", x)
else:
    print("All headline paragraphs underlined; no non-headline text underlined.")

# ensure document.xml still parseable and other parts intact
for n in z.namelist():
    pass
print("XML root tag:", root.tag.split('}')[-1])

import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

with zipfile.ZipFile(path) as z:
    entries = [(i, z.read(i.filename)) for i in z.infolist()]
    data = z.read("word/document.xml").decode("utf-8")

# collect xmlns declarations from the raw XML to restore original prefixes
for m in re.finditer(r'xmlns:([A-Za-z0-9_.-]*)\s*=\s*"([^"]+)"', data):
    ET.register_namespace(m.group(1), m.group(2))

root = ET.fromstring(data)
new_xml = '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8" standalone="yes"?>\n' + ET.tostring(
    root, encoding="unicode"
)

with zipfile.ZipFile(tmp, "w", zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as z:
    for info, content in entries:
        if info.filename == "word/document.xml":
            z.writestr(info, new_xml)
        else:
            z.writestr(info, content)

os.replace(tmp, path)
print("Rewrote document.xml with original namespace prefixes.")
